Germany wanted a 150mm gun, a 75mm gun, AA cannons and a flamethrower on the Maus. The crew of six had to dodge recoil in a tiny turret. Armor was so thick it was basically a moving bunker.
What other over-the-top WWII weapon should we cover next?
